name: Otomari Koibito Lolita
original_name: お泊まり恋人ロリータ
source:
Do you love little girl?
Comb her hair and understand each other.
Hold her hand and feel each other.
Her eyes, skin and mucous are wet
making me wanting to be her one.
With only ways to become happy in mind,
I fall in unforgivable ideal love.

[From [url=http://yorunohitsuji.xii.jp/products/lol3]Main Site Cover[/url]]
